notes.title: 2.0.8 Patch 1

notes.title: Project Zero's first big update and the future
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I wanted to take a moment to share what's currently being worked on and what you can expect in the near future for Project Zero.

First of all, thank you to everyone who has tried out Project Zero and shown interest in its development. Your feedback and support are invaluable as we continue to improve the game.

Now, let’s dive into what’s coming in the next big update Version 1.1.0:

Elimination Game Mode:
Originally planned for the Early Access release, this mode wasn’t quite ready at launch. However, it will be fully playable in this update, so get ready for some intense elimination rounds!

Bomb Game Mode Enhancements:
We’re introducing a buy system that will allow players to purchase the weapons they want to use each round.
To support this, a new money system will reward players at the end of each round. More details on this will be shared later.

Additionally, we’re adding flashbang and smoke grenades to enhance your tactical options in this mode.

Interactive Tutorial:
We’re replacing the old 'New User Introduction' with an interactive tutorial. In it, you’ll learn the basics of movement and shooting to help you get started on the right foot.

Proximity Chat:
To enhance team communication, Proximity Chat will be enabled in Bomb and Elimination modes, making coordination with teammates more dynamic and realistic.

Game Economy Update:
We’ll be testing new values for how coins are earned. Players will earn more coins based on their experience (EXP), which should make progression more rewarding.

I’ll post the full patch notes once it's time to release it.

Looking Ahead:

Please note that some of these plans may change in the future

Events:
If all goes well, I will have in-game events designed to increase player engagement and add more excitement to the game. Something I had in mind was an EXP event where players get double or triple the normal amount.

Prestige System:
Once you hit level 100, you’ll be able to prestige. This system will display your prestige level on the scoreboard and in the main menu.
With each prestige, you’ll unlock exclusive prestige-only weapon skins and earn coins as rewards.

Networking & Matchmaking Overhaul:
I’ve been considering a switch to a new networking solution for some time now, though this will require significant rewriting of the game’s core systems.

However, the effort will be worth it as it will greatly improve the quality of gameplay. Along with the networking change, I have planned to introduce a matchmaking system that assigns ranks, ensuring you’ll be matched with players of similar skill levels for a more balanced experience.

To see what is being worked on, go check out Project Zero's Roadmap!

That’s all for now! I’ll keep you updated as we get closer to these exciting changes.

Thank you, and have a great day!

notes.title: AI Development Update
notes.content:
Hello!

It's time to let you guys know how the AI rework has been going since the last development update.

I have managed to complete weapon switching, animations, movement and some other small stuff.

Right now I would say it's in a great state, but there are still some things I need to improve.

It's coming together slowly, but it will get there!

The AI has some new features for example weapon switching, field of view detection (there really wasn't a detection system before), bots will have different loadouts, bots will know the last location of their enemy if lost vision and will go to that spot, and many other.

Obviously even though the AI will seem fine to me at some point, I need feedback from the players to improve it even more.

Let's go through what has changed.

ADDED

 Now when staying inside a molotov, the damage you take increases.
 Added new options: Refresh Rate and Shadow Quality.
 Added Hit Sound for headshot.
 Added an pop up for Gun Game which shows what weapon you are going to get next.

 Added translation for Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Turkish, Korean, German, Finnish and French.

notes.title: Monthly Recap: October's Development Progress
notes.content:

2. [Performance improvements & bug fixes]: I have again been optimizing the game as much as I can and fixing bugs for the next playtest.

3. [Localization]: I have started doing some localization for the next playtest, because not everyone understands english.

The roadmap is exactly the same from the last one, nothing new yet.

notes.title: Development Log 11
notes.content:
Hello you all!

There has been some progress since the last Development Log. Let's get in to it!

Development Progress Update:

1. [Bot Improvements]: This is currently on hold because of alot of time wasted on stuff which I had to delete. I have made some progress on this though, like AI behaviour somewhat working, detection, etc.

2. [Overhauled Recoil system]: This new system now uses recoil patterns so every weapon will have it's own. Below is an link to a video of the AK-47's recoil pattern (Not final).

3. [New Networking System]: I talked about switching the networking solution some time ago. I have made some progress with the new system, but not nothing huge yet. Still testing and learning new stuff. I'll keep you updated on the progress when I feel like it's necessary.

4. [Hit Sound]: I added headshot sound and a body shot sound whenever you shoot an enemy.

5. [Castle Rework]: I had this on my to-do list for a long time, but now finally I was able to start reworking the map. The map is "done" which means that it's playable, but I need to add textures, etc.

6. [Performance improvements & bug fixes]: I have been working on improving the performance and fixing some small bugs.

7. [Settings]: Added Refresh Rate dropdown and Shadow Quality options.

8. [Grenade improvements]: I improved how the grenades are being thrown and reworked how the damaging works. Before the grenade checked once if a player was inside the explosion radius even if the player moved away the player would still take damage. Now it won't damage you if you move away from the grenade.

9. [Crouch Spam]: I have been working on crouch spam prevention to make gun play more balanced gameplay.

notes.content:
Hello and welcome to the 9th development log.
This is a complete new style I'm trying.

Development Progress Update:

I'm pleased to let you know about some of the progress I have made!

1. [Molotov Damage Rework]: I have reworked the Molotov's damage mechanics so now the longer a player stays inside the Molotov, the more damage they take.

2. [Grenade Damage Radius]: I have reduced the radius based on feedback to ensure more balanced gameplay.

3. [Bot Improvements]: Bots have received significant improvements. They are now able to take damage from Grenades and Molotovs and better navigation on City map for better gameplay experience.

4. [Maps]: I have been working on enhancing visual appeal of various maps by improving lighting and textures.

5. [Gun Game]: Now the UI shows the next weapon you are going to get.

6. [Grenade & Molotov Sounds]: Modified how far away/how close you can hear a Grenade explosion and Molotov fire.

Upcoming Features and Content:

Here's a sneak peek at what's to come:

1. [Headshot Sound]: Soon, when players land a headshot, a distinct sound will accompany it, adding to the satisfaction of precise shooting.

2. [Team Selection Screen]: I have decided to completely rework the team selection screen to look way nicer.

3. [Bot Improvements]: To make bots feel more "realistic", they should be able to switch to secondary when no ammo is left or to throw grenade/molotov.

notes.title: Playtest 4
notes.content:
Hello again!

In the last post I briefly talked about the next milestone being Playtest 4, so the time has come.

Playtest will start on May 31st till June 25th. But what has changed?

ADDED

 Implemented a small notification dot to Lobby Chat to indicate new messages.
 Added Hitmark trigger when someone takes damage from your molotov/grenade.


BUG FIXES

 Fixed the issue where Lobby Chat was displaying numbers as user nicknames.
 Resolved the problem that prevented users from sending messages in Room Chat.
 Corrected sniper accuracy while in air and scoping.
 Fixed a game-breaking bug related to Free-for-All (FFA) and Gun Game.
 Fixed a critical bug related to Team Switching, which caused the game to crash.
 Fixed the issue where Room Chat was not showing up when a new message was received.
 Resolved a problem with Notifications in FFA and Gun Game.
 Addressed various other bugs and stability issues.


IMPROVEMENTS

 Made enhancements to all Game Mode codebases to perform better.
 Improved networking for smoother and more reliable online gameplay experience.
 Improved overall performance of the game for better responsiveness and smoother gameplay.


REMOVED

 Removed BOMB Game Mode temporarily to allow for a complete overhaul.


WEAPON UPDATES

 Finalized AK-47 and UMP-45 animations.


If you encounter any problems with the game, please be sure to report them either on our Discord server or on Steam.
